description.narrative: The UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) programme ‘Debt Management and Financial Analysis System’ (DMFAS) provides technical cooperation and advisory services in the area of debt management, an area of increasing significance as a result of the economic fallout from the COVID-19 global pandemic. Its mission is to assist countries in strengthening their capacity to manage their debt with the ultimate objective of promoting better use of public financial resources to improve people’s living conditions. DMFAS is integrated as a key activity of our main partner UNCTAD and has been successful in helping governments improve their capacity to manage debt for more than 40 years. So far, it has worked at the country level with 75 (most of whom are low and lower-middle income) and with 116 institutions. The programme helps build capacity at country level in support of good governance, development and poverty reduction.
